patch.scope: Private opt-in M5Pro compact expert/token tile dispatch after original route map. Q2_0 gate/up [2560,640,512] and down [640,2560,512], F32 contiguous activations/output, I32 top10 IDs, T32..512, DEFAULT/F32 source precision and exact stock MM eligibility. GPU prefix worklist uses own appended allocation after unchanged amax, bounded static dispatch, same matrix arithmetic with function-constant expert/tile remap. Allocation, overlap, alignment and layout guards fall back; invalid GPU count or capacity fails closed. Private encoding counter and once-only encoded marker. No route-map reuse, graph reorder, model/cache/precision/default changes.
